gates.name: Gallery media and teaser regression
gates.command: uv run --locked --env-file .env.local python -m pytest tests/promo/test_promo_gallery_media.py tests/promo/test_promo_display_api.py

title: Serve authorized fixed Promo gallery media
purpose: Make the fixed gallery readable only by its venue display principal through promo-owned authorization.
success_outcome: Gallery members return no-store reduced JPEG through the new path; invalid/foreign/nonmember/unavailable reads disclose nothing, preserve the strict old teaser route and mutate no domain state.
anti_goals: No selection or persisted gallery-publication implementation; those outcomes belong to TASK-140/141.
No client UI, credential lifecycle, public-phone date policy or deployment changes.

forbidden_scope: Production/default database mutation or credential disclosure
Session selection/publication and gallery schema changes
Client UI and foreign capability writes
stop_conditions: Media access requires expanding accepted authority or a new owner/edge.
Security probes cannot be isolated and cleaned safely.

verification_targets: FT-005-AC-008: use disposable PostgreSQL plus task-owned preview/original fixtures and real display authentication through HTTP. Probe matched issuing-revision and common no_faces JPEG, content type/no-store, missing/invalid/reset/inactive principal 401; foreign session/photo, nonmember, missing issuing revision/bytes, hard-purged and legacy-null gallery 404. An additional gallery member stays 404 on the old teaser route. Read only through public inventory/processing providers; inspect primary-key lookup and no historical scans.

FT-005-AC-008: snapshot session/Attempt, union/N, ticket/expiry/browser access and processing rows before/after reads including failures; prove no mutation or replacement selection, no raw keys/presigned/original delivery and no credential/result logging. Use unique disposable IDs, rerun from the same initial fixture and clean only task-owned database/objects on success or failure.
evidence_required: FT-005-AC-008 RED: baseline valid fixed gallery request cannot deliver the authorized member at the new route; GREEN: same authorized fixture returns reduced JPEG and all scoped denial/strict-teaser cases return the contract statuses with unchanged state. Decisive comparison: sanitized HTTP matrix, provider/revision observations and before/after snapshots; artifact: focused test transcript under .tasks/TASK-142-T3-FT-005-W9/.
